nodes.name: 00_mod.mk
nodes.summary: Defines the shared configuration defaults for the license-generation module, currently exposing the empty `license_ignore` allowlist that callers can override.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the `?=` operator so downstream repositories can override defaults without editing the vendored module.

nodes.name: 01_mod.mk
nodes.summary: Generates per-module LICENSES files with go-licenses and packages them as OCI image layers so release artifacts carry dependency license information.
nodes.languageNotes: Creates a scratch go.work file so go-licenses resolves local modules correctly, and uses `define`/`eval` macros to template a rule per Go module.

nodes.name: licenses.tmpl
nodes.summary: go-licenses text/template that renders the header guidance plus a dependency-name/license-name table into each generated LICENSES file.
nodes.languageNotes: Go template syntax with `range`/trim markers; the tool appends one `Name,LicenseName` row per dependency.

nodes.name: 01_mod.mk
nodes.summary: Provides the `generate-base` target that copies the repository-base template tree into the consuming repo, substituting the GitHub repository name and bootstrapping a Renovate config when absent.
nodes.languageNotes: Requires `repo_name` to be set and rewrites the `{{REPLACE:GH-REPOSITORY}}` placeholder in every copied file with sed.

nodes.name: make-self-upgrade.sts.yaml
nodes.summary: Chainguard Octo STS trust policy that lets the make-self-upgrade workflow on main or master exchange its OIDC token for a GitHub token with contents, pull request, and workflow write access.

nodes.name: renovate.sts.yaml
nodes.summary: Octo STS trust policy granting the Renovate workflow broad repository permissions (administration read, contents/issues/PR/workflow write, statuses) for automated dependency updates.

nodes.name: make-self-upgrade.yaml
nodes.summary: Scheduled GitHub Actions workflow that bumps the vendored makefile-modules via `make upgrade-klone` and `make generate`, then pushes a self-upgrade branch and opens a labelled pull request.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Octo STS token exchange plus actions/github-script to create and label the automated PR.

nodes.name: renovate.yaml
nodes.summary: Nightly GitHub Actions workflow that runs a self-hosted Renovate bot with a short-lived Octo STS token to keep dependencies of the repository up to date.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Generated repository-base Makefile prelude that configures strict make/shell behaviour, derives host, git and artifact variables, and includes the repository's modular make fragments.
nodes.languageNotes: Relies on `.SECONDEXPANSION` and `--warn-undefined-variables` so tool targets are resolved late and undefined variables fail loudly.

nodes.name: OWNERS_ALIASES
nodes.summary: Generated Kubernetes OWNERS alias file mapping the `cm-maintainers` alias to the list of cert-manager maintainer GitHub handles.

nodes.name: renovate-bootstrap-config.json5
nodes.summary: Minimal JSON5 Renovate bootstrap config that extends the shared cert-manager Renovate preset and is copied to `.github/renovate.json5` when a repo has none.

nodes.name: 00_mod.mk
nodes.summary: Central tooling module that pins every CLI and Go tool version, downloads and symlinks them into `_bin/tools`, and defines go-version, vendoring, and tool-listing targets used by all other make fragments.
nodes.languageNotes: Renovate annotations above each version pin drive automated bumps; binaries live in a shared cache and are exposed through versioned symlinks on PATH.

nodes.name: 01_mod.mk
nodes.summary: Include-only aggregator for the newer Helm module set, pulling in CRD generation unless disabled and always including the chart and deploy fragments.

nodes.name: crds.mk
nodes.summary: Defines `generate-crds`, which runs controller-gen across Go packages and wraps each CRD in Helm templating before writing manifests into the chart and deploy/crds directory.
nodes.languageNotes: Copies the chart source to a temp dir per build and uses BSD/GNU-compatible in-place sed detection based on HOST_OS.

nodes.name: deploy.mk
nodes.summary: Adds `install`, `uninstall`, and `template` targets that drive Helm against the current Kubernetes cluster using the packaged chart archive.

nodes.name: helm.mk
nodes.summary: Packages, publishes, documents, and verifies the Helm chart, including OCI push, values schema/docs generation, linting, kubeconform validation, and Kyverno pod-security checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Fails fast on a missing `v` prefix in the chart version, then rewrites Chart.yaml annotations before `helm package`.

nodes.name: base_images.mk
nodes.summary: Autogenerated variable definitions pinning digest-addressed distroless static and dynamic base images for each supported CPU architecture.

nodes.name: ci.mk
nodes.summary: Repository-specific CI targets that verify Go modules and the chart, run errexit checks, regenerate Kubernetes codegen, and produce Helm docs and values schema.

nodes.name: cluster.yaml
nodes.summary: Unversioned kind cluster configuration used by end-to-end tests, tuning a single control-plane node with a fixed service subnet and etcd fsync disabled for speed.

nodes.name: kustomization.yaml
nodes.summary: Kustomize overlay that pulls upstream Kyverno pod-security and best-practice policies and patches them to Enforce mode while excluding non-compliant E2E test namespaces.

nodes.name: policy.yaml
nodes.summary: Generated multi-document bundle of Kyverno ClusterPolicies enforcing Kubernetes Pod Security Standards and best practices, with exceptions for end-to-end test namespaces.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains roughly nineteen `---`-separated ClusterPolicy documents that must be regenerated with `kustomize build`, never edited by hand.

nodes.name: lib.sh
nodes.summary: Bash helper library sourced by E2E scripts that defines the shared IP layout and provides colorized output and command tracing utilities.
nodes.languageNotes: Enables nounset/errexit/pipefail and silently disables ANSI colors when CI=true or NO_COLOR is set.

nodes.name: should_color
nodes.summary: Returns success when colored terminal output is appropriate, refusing color under CI or when NO_COLOR is set.

nodes.name: color
nodes.summary: Streams stdin line by line, stripping pre-existing ANSI escapes and re-emitting each line wrapped in the requested color code.

nodes.name: trace
nodes.summary: Echoes a quoted, colorized representation of a command and its arguments with awk, then executes it.
nodes.languageNotes: The awk program double-quotes arguments containing spaces, braces, globs, or question marks for shell-safe display.

nodes.name: Containerfile.pebble
nodes.summary: Minimal container image definition that layers the pebble ACME test server binary onto a caller-supplied base image and runs it as the non-root user 1000.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a build ARG for the base image so the same Containerfile works with the digest-pinned distroless images.

nodes.name: .helmignore
nodes.summary: Helm packaging ignore list that excludes VCS metadata, editor files, backups, and OS artifacts from the pebble chart archive.

nodes.name: Chart.yaml
nodes.summary: Metadata for the pebble Helm chart used to run the mock ACME server during end-to-end tests.
